audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart gives Ziggs all 7 stages while the matchup wins only 21.74% over 23 games, and the mirror audit (karma__ziggs) already set row 0 to Karma and row 1 to Skill.
audit.why: Karma's Inner Flame is 950 range against Ziggs' 850 Q, and Satchel is not available until level 2, so level 1 is hers.
audit.corrected: Row 0 -> Karma, row 1 -> Skill on both layers; rows 2-6 left as the mirror has them.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0..1].why described a level-1 range edge Ziggs does not have and gave no cooldown numbers.
audit.why: Packet defect: zero cooldown-sequencing cues in the whole matchup.
audit.corrected: Rewrote the first two stage whys around the 950-vs-850 range gap and Satchel's 20s rank-1 cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing anywhere states that Focused Resolve only roots if the tether survives, or that Ziggs' own Satchel displacement is the break.
audit.why: This is the decisive interaction of the lane and the mirror audit already recorded it from Karma's side.
audit.corrected: Stated it with both endpoints (her W 12s at every rank, Satchel 20s rank 1 / 12s rank 5) in report[5] and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Grievous Wounds timing anywhere, though Mantra-W heals Karma through chip.
audit.why: missingInteractions rule needs-antiheal for this exact pairing.
audit.corrected: Added the anti-heal buy to breakdown.mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.late says 'the low emerald win rate' — a rank mention that would bin the whole edit at the write.
audit.why: Elo tiers are stripped; the sentence must state the behaviour instead.
audit.corrected: Rewrote to 'against anyone who holds W for your step-up'.

edits.before: Q bombs out-range every melee tool in the game — chunk Karma on every last-hit attempt, but respect early minion aggro.
edits.after: Inner Flame reaches 950 to your Q's 850 and costs her 40 mana — she wins the level-1 poke exchange, so farm and sidestep.

edits.before: W Satchel online — your disengage button. You can now take a greedy trade and blast yourself out of the answer.
edits.after: W Satchel online at 20s — it displaces you out of Focused Resolve's 675 tether before the root lands. Even from here.

edits.before: Level 1 your Q out-ranges Karma's Inner Flame for free early poke.
edits.after: Level 1 Inner Flame is 950 to your Q's 850 — she pokes first here.

edits.before: Level 2 you keep chunking her while she can't close the range gap.
edits.after: Level 2 Satchel is up, so you can blast out of her W tether.

edits.before: Track Karma’s Focused Resolve (Tether): The root tether — break it with range or line of sight. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Focused Resolve tethers at 675: W Satchel displaces you out and the root never lands. Her W is 12s, your Satchel 20s at rank 1.

edits.before: - Karma Focused Resolve (Tether): matchup-defining — The root tether — break it with range or line of sight. Check it before every step-up. - W Satchel is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Karma Focused Resolve (Tether): 12s at every rank — it roots only if the tether holds, so walk out of 675 or Satchel yourself out. - W Satchel is 20s at rank 1 and 12s at rank 5; that gap is your whole safety. - Mantra is 40s. Hold R for kills.

edits.before: Shove, chip, and win the mana war. Once Blackfire Torch completes, Karma farms at half HP forever — call jungle dives on anyone chipped below 60%.
edits.after: Shove, chip, and win the mana war. Mantra-W heals her through chip, so have Grievous Wounds before you commit — then call dives on anyone chipped below 60%.

edits.before: Your poke keeps snowballing the lane on paper, but the low emerald win rate says her Mantra shields and roam pressure claw value back, so respect her W root and don't over-extend.
edits.after: Your poke looks dominant on paper, but her Mantra shields and roam pressure claw the value back against anyone who holds W for your step-up, so respect the root and don't over-extend.
